title: contract-6 result payload
description: The verdict payload Scroll POSTs fire-and-forget to a schema's resultCallbackUrl on submit. Deliberately consumer-blind: pass/fail/counts only, no per-test detail, no Scroll internals (Verdict.cases is dropped). A consumer keys delivery by the correlation it baked into resultCallbackUrl, not by any field here.

endpointId.description: Browser-minted endpoint id. Opaque to the consumer; not a correlation key.

status.description: pass = all tests passed within budget; fail = wrong answer; tle = a test exceeded the TLE budget; error = a test threw.

withinBudget.description: False iff any test timed out.

total.description: Total test count (>=1; at least one hidden oracle).
